Coram : R.V. RAVEENDRAN*, H.L. GOKHALE
CODE OF CIVIL PROCEDURE, 1908: c 0. 2, r. 2 - HELD: A suit cannot be dismissed as barred by 0. 2 r.2 in the absence of plea by defendant to that effect and in the absence of an issue thereon - Besides, in the instant case, cause of action for the second suit being completely different from the under 0. 2, r. 2 was not attracted. s.11, Explanations Ill and IV- Res-judicata - Principles explained - Constructive res judicata - HELD: Plea of res judicata must be clearly established, more particularly, where the bar is sought on the basis of constructive res-judicata - E In the instant
